Three Days Olive Value Addition (Olive Soap) Activity Completed Successfully

“The Center for Entrepreneurship, University of Loralai, successfully completed an intensive “Three Days Olive Value Addition (Olive Soap) Activity” conducted by expert trainer Muhammad Tahir.”

Official Session Visuals

1 of 4 Photos

Cohort 1 Incubation — Photo 1

Session Report & Outcomes

The Center for Entrepreneurship (CoE), University of Loralai, successfully organized and completed an intensive “Three Days Olive Value Addition (Olive Soap) Activity” aimed at equipping students, incubatees, and local youth with practical skills in agro-based cottage industrial production.

The hands-on workshop was conducted by specialist trainer Muhammad Tahir, who guided participants through the complete technical lifecycle of artisanal and commercial-grade olive soap manufacturing. The training emphasized utilizing locally grown olive harvests from Balochistan to foster regional value chains and high-margin finished consumer goods.

Over the course of three practical days, participants learned essential chemistry principles of saponification, cold-process and warm-process soap preparation, optimal oil blending ratios, natural herbal infusion techniques, and skin-safety pH balancing.

The training also included practical modules on product finishing, curing protocols, packaging design, quality assurance standards, and commercial pricing models to enable participants to launch micro-cottage brands and commercialize their creations.

The initiative was organized under the leadership and coordination of Focal Person Dr. Abdul Salam Maftoon and Coordinator Muhammad Luqman, with the visionary backing of Worthy Vice Chancellor Engr. Prof. Dr. Ehsanullah Kakar to transform Balochistan's agricultural resources into profitable self-employment and entrepreneurial opportunities.

Core Workshop Focus & Practical Competencies

Saponification Chemistry & Oil Blending

Mastering cold-process and warm-process soap formulation, oil-to-lye precision ratios, and moisture curing.

Balochistan Olive Harvest Value Addition

Unlocking high-margin commercial potential from locally grown olives for regional and national consumer markets.

Organic Formulation & Quality Standards

Hands-on creation of chemical-free, nutrient-rich soaps infused with regional natural herbs and essential oils.

Packaging, Branding & Cottage Launch

Commercial packaging, retail labeling guidelines, unit cost accounting, and cottage business startup strategy.
